text:
Stop wasting your hunger on dead ends.

It's 3 a.m. You're messaging someone who doesn't think about you.

That's hunger. Channeling it into people is the trap.

Redirect it into your craft.

Same fire. Same intensity.

That becomes infectious. That's enthusiasm.

The men who own rooms are doing this one thing.

That's the only thing separating men who move people from those who fade.
caption:
It's 3 a.m. and your hunger is being wasted. Most men never redirect it. Redirect yours.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
